title: SQL injection in findBookings
description: userId and q are concatenated straight into the SQL string. Any quote in q escapes the literal. Use parameterised placeholders.

title: Session token is a predictable MD5 of userId and timestamp
description: md5 over userId plus Date.now() is guessable: an attacker who knows the user id can brute force the millisecond. Use randomBytes from a CSPRNG.

title: isCancellable divides by the wrong unit
description: startsAt is epoch milliseconds, so dividing the difference by 3600 yields kiloseconds, not hours. The divisor should be 3600000.

title: validateSession accepts expired sessions
description: Both branches of the expires check return s.userId, so the expiry test has no effect and an expired token still authenticates.

title: pageOffset is off-by-one for 1-based pages
description: With a 1-based page parameter, page * size skips the first page entirely. It should be (page - 1) * size.

title: applyCredit allows a negative balance
description: There is no check that costPence is covered, so the balance can be overdrawn below zero.

title: reserve has a check-then-act race
description: The capacity read and the write are separate statements, so two concurrent reservations both pass the check and oversell the event. Needs an atomic conditional update or a transaction.

title: nextRef uses a module-level counter
description: The counter is per-process and in-memory, so references collide across instances and restart from REF-1 on redeploy.

title: loadAttendees issues an N+1 query
description: One query per event id in a loop. Use a single query with an IN clause.

title: summarise is quadratic
description: A nested filter over the whole array inside the loop recounts every row per row, making it O(n^2). Accumulate counts in one pass.
